use_policy: Sources inform scenario design and public contracts. No source code, raw dataset rows, real incident reports or proprietary TSMC data are redistributed. Unless explicitly stated, a reference supplies operational context, not evidence that the authored bug occurred in that dataset.

nist-sms.title: NIST Smart Manufacturing Systems Test Bed
nist-sms.kind: Physical manufacturing and inspection test bed with published telemetry
nist-sms.limitation: The repair bugs and simplified service interfaces are authored; they are not NIST bug reports. Data-package reuse requires checking its own notices.

mtconnect-2.0.title: MTConnect Standard Part 1.0 Fundamentals, Version 2.0.0
mtconnect-2.0.limitation: Only R23 directly models the advertised nextSequence contract. Acknowledgement and retention tasks are engineering extensions, not claims of MTConnect conformance. Specification licensing applies to the original document; it is not bundled.

production-log.title: Production Analysis with Process Mining Technology (Dafna Levy, 2014)
production-log.limitation: Reticles, semiconductor lot lineage and software faults are synthetic extensions of production-flow concepts, not fields or incidents attributed to this source.

zema-hydraulic.title: Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems (Helwig, Pignanelli and Schuetze)
zema-hydraulic.limitation: The rig is not a semiconductor fab. Calibration, quantile and integration defects are authored scenarios.

secom.title: SECOM (Michael McCann and Adrian Johnston, 2008)
secom.kind: Semiconductor process measurements and test labels
secom.limitation: The provider is not identified as TSMC. Classification data contains no reference software patches.

bosch.title: Bosch Production Line Performance
informs: sparse joins across numeric, categorical and date files
bosch.license_observed: Competition-specific rules; no blanket redistribution permission assumed
bosch.limitation: Schema concepts only. No competition files were imported or redistributed.

bpi-2019.title: BPI Challenge 2019 (Boudewijn van Dongen)
bpi-2019.kind: Anonymized purchase-order event log from a coatings and paints company
bpi-2019.license_observed: Dataset-specific terms must be checked before raw-data reuse
bpi-2019.limitation: This is procurement rather than machine telemetry. Quantity-based matching and compensation are deliberately simplified authored contracts.
